C0259.title: Hackers Divert Platform Users to Unlicensed Medical Aesthetic Clinics via Illegal Traffic Scheme
C0259.summary: Police in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province dismantled a criminal gang that used hacking techniques to divert online traffic. The group cracked platform APIs to scrape data on users interested in medical aesthetics, then fabricated its own consumer experiences and used private chats to steer users to unlicensed offline clinics. News reports said the group illegally obtained more than 50 million personal-information records and made over RMB 30 million, while later procuratorial material identified more than RMB 6 million in illegal proceeds.
